title: The Book of Joshua Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Joshua — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the Lord it came to pass, that the Lord spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,
verses.decoded: After Moses, the servant of the LORD, died, the LORD spoke to Joshua, the son of Nun, who was Moses’ assistant, saying,

verses.kjv: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Moses, my servant, is dead; so now get up, cross this Jordan River, you and all these people, to the land that I am giving to them, to the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
verses.decoded: Every place where the sole of your foot steps, I have given to you, just as I told Moses.

verses.kjv: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
verses.decoded: From the desert and this Lebanon all the way to the great river, the Euphrates River, including all the land of the Hittites, and extending to the great sea in the west, will be your border.

verses.kjv: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.decoded: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. Just as I was with Moses, I will be with you. I will not fail you or abandon you.

verses.kjv: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.
verses.decoded: Be strong and courageous, because you will give this land as an inheritance to these people, just as I promised their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
verses.decoded: Be strong and very courageous, so that you obey all the law that Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may succeed wherever you go.

verses.kjv: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
verses.decoded: This book of the law must not leave your mouth; instead, you must think about it day and night, so that you obey everything written in it. Then your path will be successful, and you will have good results.

verses.kjv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.decoded: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid, and do not be discouraged, because the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

verses.kjv: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
verses.decoded: Then Joshua gave orders to the leaders of the people, saying,

verses.kjv: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the Lord your God giveth you to possess it.
verses.decoded: Go through the army and tell the people, 'Get your food ready, because within three days you will cross this Jordan River to enter and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you.'

verses.kjv: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
verses.decoded: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half of the tribe of Manasseh, saying,

verses.kjv: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, The Lord your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
verses.decoded: Remember the message that Moses, the servant of the LORD, told you, saying, The LORD your God has given you rest and has given you this land.

verses.kjv: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;
verses.decoded: Your wives, your children, and your cattle will stay in the land that Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan; but you will go ahead of your brothers, all the strong and brave men, armed and ready, and help them.

verses.kjv: Until the Lord have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the Lord your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the Lord’s servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.decoded: Until the LORD has given your brothers rest, just as he has given you, and they have also taken possession of the land that the LORD your God gives them, then you will return to the land you own and enjoy it, which Moses, the LORD’s servant, gave you on this side of the Jordan River toward the east.

verses.kjv: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
verses.decoded: And they answered Joshua, saying, Everything you command us we will do, and wherever you send us, we will go.

verses.kjv: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the Lord thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
verses.decoded: Just as we listened to Moses in everything, we will listen to you. May the LORD your God be with you, just as he was with Moses.

verses.kjv: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
verses.decoded: Whoever rebels against your command and does not listen to your words in everything you command them will be put to death. Just be strong and courageous.

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
verses.decoded: Joshua, the son of Nun, sent two men secretly from Shittim, saying, Go and look at the land, especially Jericho. They went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab, and stayed there.

verses.kjv: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
verses.decoded: The king of Jericho was told, "Look, men from the children of Israel came here tonight to explore the land."

verses.kjv: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
verses.decoded: The king of Jericho sent a message to Rahab, saying, Bring out the men who have come to you and entered your house, because they have come to explore the entire land.

verses.kjv: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:
verses.decoded: The woman took the two men, hid them, and said, 'Some men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.
verses.decoded: It happened around the time the gate was closing, when it was dark, that the men left. I do not know where the men went. Chase after them quickly, because you will catch them.

verses.kjv: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
verses.decoded: But she took them up to the roof of the house and hid them among the stalks of flax that she had arranged on the roof.

verses.kjv: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
verses.decoded: The men chased after them along the road to the Jordan River at the crossing points, and as soon as those who were chasing them had left, they closed the gate.

verses.kjv: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
verses.decoded: Before they went to sleep, she came up to them on the roof;

verses.kjv: And she said unto the men, I know that the Lord hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.
verses.decoded: And she said to the men, I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that your fear has come upon us, and that all the people living in the land are terrified because of you.

verses.kjv: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.
verses.decoded: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites on the other side of the Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the Lord your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
verses.decoded: As soon as we heard these things, our hearts melted, and no one had any more courage because of you, for the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the Lord, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:
verses.decoded: So now, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have shown you kindness, that you will also show kindness to my father’s family and give me a reliable sign.

verses.kjv: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
verses.decoded: And that you will keep my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters, and everything they own alive, and save our lives from death.

verses.kjv: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the Lord hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.
verses.decoded: The men answered her, "Our lives are for yours if you do not reveal this mission of ours. And when the LORD gives us the land, we will treat you kindly and faithfully."

verses.kjv: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
verses.decoded: Then she lowered them down with a rope through the window because her house was built on the city wall, and she lived on the wall.

verses.kjv: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.
verses.decoded: And she said to them, Go to the mountain, so that the pursuers will not find you; and hide there for three days, until the pursuers return; then you can continue on your way.

verses.kjv: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.
verses.decoded: And the men said to her, We will be innocent regarding this oath you have made us swear.

verses.kjv: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.
verses.decoded: Look, when we enter the land, you will tie this scarlet thread in the window through which you let us down; and you will bring your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household to your home.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.
verses.decoded: And it will be that whoever leaves the doors of your house and goes into the street, their own blood will be on their head, and we will not be responsible; but whoever stays with you inside the house, their blood will be on our head if anyone harms them.

verses.kjv: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
verses.decoded: And if you reveal this matter of ours, then we will be released from the oath you made us swear.

verses.kjv: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
verses.decoded: And she said, As you have said, so be it. Then she let them go, and they left. She tied the scarlet cord in the window.

verses.kjv: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.
verses.decoded: They went and came to the mountain and stayed there for three days until the people chasing them returned. The pursuers searched for them all along the way but did not find them.

verses.kjv: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:
verses.decoded: So the two men came back, went down from the mountain, crossed over, and came to Joshua son of Nun, and told him everything that had happened to them.

verses.kjv: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the Lord hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
verses.decoded: And they said to Joshua, Truly the LORD has given all the land into our hands; because even all the people living in the country are losing heart because of us.

verses.kjv: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
verses.decoded: Joshua got up early in the morning; he and all the children of Israel left Shittim and came to the Jordan River, and they stayed there before crossing over.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;
verses.decoded: After three days, the officers went through the army;

verses.kjv: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.
verses.decoded: They commanded the people, saying, When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests, the Levites, carrying it, then you must leave your place and follow it.

verses.kjv: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.
verses.decoded: There will be a gap of about two thousand cubits between you and it; do not come near it so that you will know the path you must take, because you have not traveled this way before.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the Lord will do wonders among you.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to the people, Set yourselves apart: because tomorrow the LORD will perform amazing things among you.

verses.kjv: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
verses.decoded: And Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, Pick up the ark of the covenant and lead the people across. So they picked up the ark of the covenant and went ahead of the people.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to Joshua, Today I will start to make you great in the eyes of all Israel, so they will know that just as I was with Moses, I will also be with you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.
verses.decoded: And you shall command the priests who carry the ark of the covenant, saying, When you come to the edge of the Jordan River, you shall stand still in the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the Lord your God.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, Come here, and listen to the words of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said, By this you will know that the living God is among you, and that he will certainly drive out from before you the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

verses.kjv: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.
verses.decoded: Look, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is going ahead of you into the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.
verses.decoded: Now then, select twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man from each tribe.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.
verses.decoded: It will happen that as soon as the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, touch the waters of the Jordan River, the waters flowing down from above will stop and pile up in one place.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
verses.decoded: When the people left their tents to cross the Jordan River, the priests carried the ark of the covenant in front of the people;

verses.kjv: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)
verses.decoded: When those carrying the ark reached the Jordan River, the feet of the priests carrying the ark touched the edge of the water, because the Jordan River overflows its banks during the harvest season.

verses.kjv: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
verses.decoded: The waters flowing down from above stopped and piled up in one place far from the city of Adam, which is near Zaretan. The waters flowing toward the Dead Sea, also called the Salt Sea, dried up and were cut off. The people crossed over right in front of Jericho.

verses.kjv: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.
verses.decoded: The priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firmly on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan River, and all the Israelites crossed over on dry ground until everyone had completely crossed the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,
verses.decoded: After all the people had completely crossed over the Jordan River, the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

verses.kjv: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
verses.decoded: Choose twelve men from the people, one man from each tribe,

verses.kjv: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.
verses.decoded: And command them, saying, Take twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, from the place where the priests' feet stood firm, and carry them with you. Leave them at the place where you will stay tonight.

verses.kjv: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
verses.decoded: Then Joshua called the twelve men he had chosen from the children of Israel, one man from each tribe:

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the Lord your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to them, Cross ahead of the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan River, and each of you pick up a stone and carry it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?
verses.decoded: This will be a sign among you so that when your children ask their fathers in the future, saying, What do these stones mean?

verses.kjv: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.
verses.decoded: Then you will tell them that the waters of the Jordan River stopped flowing in front of the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan River stopped flowing. These stones will be a reminder for the children of Israel forever.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the Lord spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
verses.decoded: The Israelites did exactly as Joshua commanded. They picked up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan River, just as the LORD told Joshua, one stone for each tribe of Israel. They carried the stones with them to the place where they camped and set them down there.

verses.kjv: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
verses.decoded: Joshua placed twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan River, exactly where the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant stood; and those stones are still there today.

verses.kjv: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the Lord commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
verses.decoded: The priests carrying the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan River until everything the LORD had commanded Joshua to tell the people was completed, following all the instructions Moses had given Joshua. Then the people hurried and crossed over.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the Lord passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
verses.decoded: After all the people had completely crossed over, the ark of the LORD crossed over, and the priests did so in front of the people.

verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:
verses.decoded: The descendants of Reuben, the descendants of Gad, and half of the tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed ahead of the Israelites, just as Moses had told them.

verses.kjv: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the Lord unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
verses.decoded: About forty thousand soldiers ready for battle crossed over in front of the LORD to fight on the plains of Jericho.

verses.kjv: On that day the Lord magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
verses.decoded: On that day, the LORD made Joshua great in the eyes of all Israel; and they respected him just as they respected Moses, for all the days of his life.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
verses.decoded: Tell the priests carrying the ark of the covenant to come up out of the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.
verses.decoded: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come up out of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD came up out of the middle of the Jordan River, and the soles of the priests' feet touched the dry land, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and flowed over all its banks, just as they did before.

verses.kjv: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
verses.decoded: The people came out of the Jordan River on the tenth day of the first month and set up camp at Gilgal, on the eastern edge of Jericho.

verses.kjv: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
verses.decoded: And those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan River, Joshua set up in Gilgal.

verses.kjv: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
verses.decoded: And he spoke to the children of Israel, saying, When your children ask their fathers in the future, saying, What do these stones mean?

verses.kjv: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
verses.decoded: Then you should tell your children, saying, Israel crossed this Jordan River on dry ground.

verses.kjv: For the Lord your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the Lord your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
verses.decoded: Because the LORD your God stopped the flow of the Jordan River ahead of you until you had crossed, just as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea, stopping its waters ahead of us until we had crossed.

verses.kjv: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the Lord, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the Lord your God for ever.
verses.decoded: So that all the people of the earth will know the power of the LORD, that it is strong, and so that you will respect the LORD your God forever.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: When all the kings of the Amorites on the west side of the Jordan and all the kings of the Canaanites by the sea heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed, their hearts melted and they lost all courage because of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: At that time the Lord said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.
verses.decoded: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, Make sharp knives for yourself, and circumcise the children of Israel again for the second time.

verses.kjv: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
verses.decoded: Joshua made sharp knives for himself and circumcised the Israelites at the hill called the Hill of Foreskins.

verses.kjv: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.
verses.decoded: This is the reason why Joshua performed circumcision: All the males who came out of Egypt, including all the soldiers, died in the wilderness along the way after they left Egypt.

verses.kjv: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.
verses.decoded: All the people who came out were circumcised, but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

verses.kjv: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord: unto whom the Lord sware that he would not shew them the land, which the Lord sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.decoded: The children of Israel traveled in the wilderness for forty years until all the men who were soldiers and came out of Egypt died, because they did not obey the voice of the LORD. The LORD had sworn that he would not allow them to see the land that he promised to their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.
verses.decoded: Joshua circumcised the children of the people, whom he had raised up to replace their parents, because they were uncircumcised since they had not been circumcised during the journey.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
verses.decoded: After they finished circumcising all the people, they stayed in their places in the camp until they healed completely.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Joshua, Today I have removed the disgrace of Egypt from you. Therefore, the name of this place is called Gilgal to this day.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.
verses.decoded: The Israelites camped at Gilgal and celebrated the Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month in the plains of Jericho.

verses.kjv: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
verses.decoded: They ate some of the old grain from the land the day after the Passover, along with unleavened bread and roasted grain on that very day.

verses.kjv: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
verses.decoded: The manna stopped the day after they ate the first grain from the land; the people of Israel no longer had manna, but they ate the produce of the land of Canaan that year.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?
verses.decoded: When Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and asked, 'Are you on our side or on the side of our enemies?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?
verses.decoded: And he said, No; but I have now come as the commander of the LORD's army. Then Joshua fell face down to the ground, worshiped, and said to him, What does my lord say to his servant?

verses.kjv: And the captain of the Lord’s host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
verses.decoded: The commander of the LORD’S army said to Joshua, Take off your shoe from your foot, because the place where you are standing is holy. And Joshua did it.

verses.kjv: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.
verses.decoded: Now Jericho was tightly closed because of the Israelites: no one went out, and no one came in.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Joshua, Look, I have given Jericho into your hand, along with its king and its strong warriors.

verses.kjv: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.
verses.decoded: And you all, men of war, shall march around the city once. You will do this for six days.

verses.kjv: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.
verses.decoded: Seven priests will carry seven ram's horn trumpets in front of the ark, and on the seventh day you will march around the city seven times, while the priests blow the trumpets.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
verses.decoded: It will happen that when they blow a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people will shout loudly; and the city wall will collapse completely, and the people will go straight up into the city, each one facing forward.

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Joshua, the son of Nun, called the priests and said to them, 'Pick up the ark of the covenant, and have seven priests carry seven trumpets made from ram's horns in front of the ark of the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And he said to the people, Move forward and circle the city, and let the armed man go ahead of the ark of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the Lord, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.
verses.decoded: After Joshua spoke to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven ram’s horn trumpets went ahead of the LORD and blew the trumpets, and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

verses.kjv: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
verses.decoded: The soldiers who were armed walked in front of the priests who were blowing the trumpets, and the rear guard followed behind the ark, with the priests continuing to walk and blow the trumpets.

verses.kjv: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.
verses.decoded: And Joshua commanded the people, saying, You must not shout, or make any noise with your voice, and no word should come out of your mouth, until the day I tell you to shout; then you shall shout.

verses.kjv: So the ark of the Lord compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
verses.decoded: So the ark of the LORD went around the city once: then they returned to the camp and stayed there.

verses.kjv: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Joshua got up early in the morning, and the priests carried the ark of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the Lord, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
verses.decoded: Seven priests carrying seven ram's horn trumpets walked continually in front of the ark of the LORD, blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them, and the rear guard followed behind the ark of the LORD, while the priests continued walking and blowing the trumpets.

verses.kjv: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
verses.decoded: On the second day, they walked around the city once and then returned to the camp. They did this for six days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, they got up early at daybreak and marched around the city in the same way seven times. Only on that day did they march around the city seven times.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the Lord hath given you the city.
verses.decoded: When the priests blew the trumpets for the seventh time, Joshua told the people, 'Shout, because the LORD has given you the city.'

verses.kjv: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the Lord: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
verses.decoded: The city will be under a curse, including it and everyone inside, dedicated to the LORD: only Rahab the prostitute will live, along with everyone in her house, because she hid the spies we sent.

verses.kjv: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.
verses.decoded: And you, be sure to keep yourselves away from the cursed thing, so that you do not become cursed yourselves by taking any of the cursed thing and cause the camp of Israel to be cursed and troubled.

verses.kjv: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the Lord: they shall come into the treasury of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But all the silver, gold, and vessels made of bronze and iron are dedicated to the LORD; they will be placed in the LORD's treasury.

verses.kjv: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
verses.decoded: So the people shouted when the priests blew the trumpets, and when the people heard the sound of the trumpet and shouted loudly, the wall collapsed completely. Then the people went straight into the city, each one moving directly forward, and they captured the city.

verses.kjv: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.
verses.decoded: They completely destroyed everything in the city, including men and women, young and old, as well as oxen, sheep, and donkeys, using the sword.

verses.kjv: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.
verses.decoded: But Joshua said to the two men who had explored the land, Go into the prostitute’s house and bring out the woman and everything she has, just as you promised her.

verses.kjv: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.
verses.decoded: The young men who were spies went in and brought Rahab, her father, her mother, her brothers, and everything she had; they brought out all her relatives and left them outside the camp of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: They burned the city with fire, including everything inside it; only the silver, gold, and the bronze and iron utensils were taken and placed into the treasury of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.decoded: And Joshua kept Rahab the prostitute alive, along with her father's family and everything she owned; and she lives in Israel to this day because she hid the spies that Joshua sent to scout Jericho.

verses.kjv: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the Lord, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
verses.decoded: And Joshua commanded them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man in the presence of the LORD who rises up and rebuilds this city Jericho: he will lay its foundation with his firstborn son, and he will set up its gates with his youngest son.

verses.kjv: So the Lord was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.
verses.decoded: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his reputation spread throughout the entire land.

verses.kjv: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: But the Israelites sinned by taking something that was under the ban; because Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, took some of the banned items, the LORD's anger burned against the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.
verses.decoded: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is next to Beth-aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, Go up and look over the land. And the men went up and looked over Ai.

verses.kjv: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.
verses.decoded: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, Do not let all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and attack Ai; and do not make all the people work there; because they are only a few.

verses.kjv: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
verses.decoded: So about three thousand men from the people went up there, and they ran away from the men of Ai.

verses.kjv: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
verses.decoded: The men of Ai killed about thirty-six of them because they chased them from in front of the gate all the way to Shebarim and attacked them on the way down. Because of this, the people's hearts melted and became as weak as water.

verses.kjv: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the Lord until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.
verses.decoded: And Joshua tore his clothes and fell face down on the ground in front of the ark of the LORD until evening, along with the elders of Israel, and they put dust on their heads.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord God, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!
verses.decoded: And Joshua said, Oh no, Lord GOD, why did you bring these people across the Jordan River only to hand us over to the Amorites to be destroyed? I wish we had been satisfied and stayed on the other side of the Jordan!

verses.kjv: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!
verses.decoded: O Lord, what should I say when Israel runs away from their enemies?

verses.kjv: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?
verses.decoded: Because the Canaanites and all the people living in the land will hear about this, they will surround us and destroy our reputation completely. What will you do about your great name?

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Joshua, Get up; why are you lying face down like this?

verses.kjv: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.
verses.decoded: Israel has sinned, and they have also broken my covenant which I commanded them: because they have even taken some of the accursed things, and have also stolen, and lied about it, and they have put it even among their own belongings.

verses.kjv: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.
verses.decoded: Therefore the people of Israel could not stand against their enemies, but ran away from them because they were under a curse. I will not be with you anymore unless you remove the cursed person from among you.

verses.kjv: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the Lord God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.
verses.decoded: Get up, make the people holy, and say, Make yourselves holy by tomorrow: because this is what the LORD God of Israel says, There is something cursed among you, O Israel: you cannot stand against your enemies until you remove the cursed thing from among you.

verses.kjv: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the Lord taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the Lord shall take shall come by households; and the household which the Lord shall take shall come man by man.
verses.decoded: So in the morning you will be brought forward according to your tribes: and the tribe that the LORD chooses will come forward according to its families; and the family that the LORD chooses will come forward by households; and the household that the LORD chooses will come forward person by person.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the Lord, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.
verses.decoded: And it will happen that anyone caught with the cursed item will be burned with fire, along with everything they own, because they have broken the covenant of the LORD and have acted foolishly in Israel.

verses.kjv: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:
verses.decoded: So Joshua got up early in the morning and gathered Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was chosen.

verses.kjv: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
verses.decoded: He brought the family of Judah; then he took the family of the Zarhites: he brought the family of the Zarhites one by one; and Zabdi was chosen:

verses.kjv: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
verses.decoded: He brought each member of his household one by one; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, was caught.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to Achan, My son, please give glory to the LORD God of Israel, and confess to him; and tell me now what you have done; do not hide it from me.

verses.kjv: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:
verses.decoded: And Achan replied to Joshua, and said, Yes, I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and this is what I have done:

verses.kjv: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
verses.decoded: When I saw among the captured items a beautiful Babylonian garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, I wanted them and took them; and they are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath it.

verses.kjv: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
verses.decoded: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and look, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath it.

verses.kjv: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the Lord.
verses.decoded: They took them out from inside the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the people of Israel, and placed them in front of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
verses.decoded: Joshua and all the people of Israel with him took Achan son of Zerah, along with the silver, the robe, the gold wedge, his sons, his daughters, his oxen, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and everything he owned; and they brought them to the valley of Achor.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the Lord shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? The LORD will trouble you today. And all Israel threw stones at him, and burned him with fire, after they had thrown stones at him.

verses.kjv: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
verses.decoded: They piled a large heap of stones over him, and it remains there to this day. Then the LORD stopped being angry. That is why the place was named The Valley of Achor, and it is still called that today.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
verses.decoded: The LORD said to Joshua, Do not be afraid, and do not be discouraged. Take all the soldiers with you, get up, and go to Ai. Look, I have given you the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.
verses.decoded: And you will do to Ai and its king just as you did to Jericho and its king: only the plunder and the livestock will you take for yourselves as spoil; set an ambush behind the city.

verses.kjv: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
verses.decoded: So Joshua got up, along with all the soldiers, to attack Ai. Joshua selected thirty thousand strong and brave men and sent them out during the night.

verses.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:
verses.decoded: And he gave them orders, saying, Look, you will lie in ambush against the city, right behind it; do not go far from the city, but be fully prepared.

verses.kjv: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
verses.decoded: I and all the people with me will go near the city, and when they come out to fight us, just like the first time, we will run away from them.

verses.kjv: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.
verses.decoded: (Because they will come out after us) until we have pulled them away from the city; because they will say, They are running away from us, just like before: so we will run away from them.

verses.kjv: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.
verses.decoded: Then you will get up from the ambush and capture the city, because the LORD your God will give it into your hand.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the Lord shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.
verses.decoded: And it will happen, when you have captured the city, that you will set the city on fire: according to the command of the LORD you will do. Look, I have commanded you.

verses.kjv: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
verses.decoded: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to hide in ambush, staying between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai. But Joshua stayed that night with the people.

verses.kjv: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
verses.decoded: Joshua got up early in the morning, counted the people, and went up, he and the leaders of Israel, ahead of the people to Ai.

verses.kjv: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
verses.decoded: All the people, including the soldiers who were with him, went up, approached, and arrived in front of the city, and camped on the north side of Ai. There was a valley between them and Ai.

verses.kjv: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.
verses.decoded: He took about five thousand men and positioned them to lie in wait between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

verses.kjv: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
verses.decoded: After they had positioned the people, all the army on the north side of the city, and their ambushers on the west side of the city, Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
verses.decoded: When the king of Ai saw this, he hurried and got up early, and the men of the city went out to fight against Israel, he and all his people, at the appointed time, in front of the plain; but he did not know that there were people lying in ambush behind the city against him.

verses.kjv: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
verses.decoded: Joshua and all Israel pretended to be defeated in front of them and ran away through the wilderness road.

verses.kjv: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
verses.decoded: All the people in Ai were gathered together to chase after them. They chased after Joshua and were pulled away from the city.

verses.kjv: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.
verses.decoded: No one was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel; they left the city open and chased after Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in your hand toward Ai, because I will give it into your hand. So Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

verses.kjv: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
verses.decoded: The ambush group quickly got up from their position and ran as soon as he raised his hand. They entered the city, captured it, hurried, and set the city on fire.

verses.kjv: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
verses.decoded: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw the smoke of the city rising up to heaven, and they could not escape in any direction. The people who had fled toward the wilderness turned around and attacked those who were chasing them.

verses.kjv: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
verses.decoded: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured the city and that smoke was rising from the city, they turned back and killed the men of Ai.

verses.kjv: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
verses.decoded: The other group came out of the city to attack them; so they were in the middle of Israel, some on one side and some on the other side. They struck them down so that none of them were left or escaped.

verses.kjv: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
verses.decoded: They captured the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
verses.decoded: It happened that after Israel finished killing all the people of Ai in the field, in the wilderness where they chased them, and after they had all fallen by the sword until they were completely destroyed, all the Israelites returned to Ai and attacked it with the sword.

verses.kjv: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
verses.decoded: And it happened that all who died that day, both men and women, were twelve thousand, which was all the men of Ai.

verses.kjv: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.decoded: Joshua did not withdraw his hand that held the spear until he had completely destroyed all the people living in Ai.

verses.kjv: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the Lord which he commanded Joshua.
verses.decoded: Israel took only the cattle and the loot from that city as their own possession, just as the LORD had commanded Joshua.

verses.kjv: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
verses.decoded: And Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap of ruins forever, a complete desolation up to this day.

verses.kjv: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.
verses.decoded: And the king of Ai was hung on a tree until evening; and as soon as the sun had set, Joshua ordered that they take his body down from the tree and throw it at the entrance of the city gate, and build a large pile of stones over it, which remains to this day.

verses.kjv: Then Joshua built an altar unto the Lord God of Israel in mount Ebal,
verses.decoded: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD God of Israel on Mount Ebal,

verses.kjv: As Moses the servant of the Lord commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.decoded: As Moses, the servant of the LORD, commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, they built an altar of uncut stones, on which no one had lifted any iron tool; and they offered burnt offerings to the LORD on it, and sacrificed peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: He wrote on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in front of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
verses.decoded: All Israel, along with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on this side of the ark and on that side in front of the priests, the Levites, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD. Both the foreigners living among them and those born in the land stood there; half of them faced Mount Gerizim, and half faced Mount Ebal, just as Moses, the servant of the LORD, had commanded earlier, so that they could bless the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
verses.decoded: After that, he read all the words of the law, including the blessings and the curses, exactly as they are written in the book of the law.

verses.kjv: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
verses.decoded: There was not a single word of everything that Moses commanded that Joshua did not read aloud in front of the entire assembly of Israel, including the women, the children, and the foreigners living among them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
verses.decoded: It happened that when all the kings on this side of the Jordan River, in the hills, in the valleys, and along all the coasts of the great sea opposite Lebanon—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—heard about it,

verses.kjv: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
verses.decoded: They came together to fight against Joshua and Israel, united as one.

verses.kjv: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
verses.decoded: When the people living in Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,

verses.kjv: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
verses.decoded: They acted cleverly and went pretending to be ambassadors, carrying old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn wine bottles that were tied up;

verses.kjv: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
verses.decoded: They had old shoes with patches on their feet, and old clothes on them; and all the bread they carried for food was dry and moldy.

verses.kjv: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
verses.decoded: And they went to Joshua at the camp in Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, We have come from a distant country; so now please make a treaty with us.

verses.kjv: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
verses.decoded: And the men of Israel said to the Hivites, Maybe you live among us; so how can we make a treaty with you?

verses.kjv: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
verses.decoded: And they said to Joshua, We are your servants. And Joshua said to them, Who are you? And where do you come from?

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the Lord thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
verses.decoded: And they said to him, Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the name of the LORD your God: for we have heard about him and everything he did in Egypt,

verses.kjv: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
verses.decoded: And everything he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan River, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

verses.kjv: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.
verses.decoded: Therefore our elders and all the people of our country spoke to us, saying, Take food with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say to them, We are your servants; so now make a treaty with us.

verses.kjv: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
verses.decoded: We took this bread fresh and warm from our houses on the day we left to come to you; but now, look, it is dry and moldy.

verses.kjv: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
verses.decoded: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and look, they are broken; and these our clothes and our shoes have become worn out because of the very long journey.

verses.kjv: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And the men took some of their food, and did not ask for guidance from the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
verses.decoded: And Joshua made peace with them and made a treaty with them to allow them to live, and the leaders of the assembly swore an oath to them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
verses.decoded: After three days had passed since they made a treaty with them, they found out that those people were their neighbors and that they lived among them.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel traveled and arrived at their cities on the third day. Their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
verses.decoded: The Israelites did not attack them because the leaders of the assembly had promised them by the LORD God of Israel. But the whole assembly complained against the leaders.

verses.kjv: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
verses.decoded: But all the leaders said to the entire assembly, We have made a promise to them by the LORD God of Israel: so now we cannot harm them.

verses.kjv: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
verses.decoded: This is what we will do for them; we will allow them to live, so that anger will not come upon us because of the promise we made to them.

verses.kjv: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
verses.decoded: And the leaders said to them, Let them live; but let them cut wood and carry water for the entire community; just as the leaders had promised them.

verses.kjv: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
verses.decoded: And Joshua called them and said to them, Why have you deceived us by saying, We are very far from you, when you actually live among us?

verses.kjv: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
verses.decoded: Now, because of this, you are cursed, and none of you will be released from being servants, cutting wood and carrying water for the house of my God.

verses.kjv: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the Lord thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.decoded: And they answered Joshua and said, Because it was certainly told your servants how the LORD your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land before you, we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and we have done this.

verses.kjv: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
verses.decoded: And now, look, we are in your hands: do to us whatever seems good and right to you.

verses.kjv: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.
verses.decoded: And he did the same for them and saved them from the power of the children of Israel so that they did not kill them.

verses.kjv: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the Lord, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
verses.decoded: And Joshua made them that day woodcutters and water carriers for the assembly and for the altar of the LORD, even to this day, in the place that he would choose.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
verses.decoded: Now it happened that when Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, heard how Joshua had captured Ai and completely destroyed it, just as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king; and how the people of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were living among them;

verses.kjv: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
verses.decoded: They were very afraid because Gibeon was a large city, one of the royal cities, and it was bigger than Ai, and all its men were strong.

verses.kjv: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.decoded: Therefore Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, sent to Hoham, king of Hebron, and to Piram, king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia, king of Lachish, and to Debir, king of Eglon, saying,

verses.kjv: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Come up to me and help me so that we can attack Gibeon because it has made peace with Joshua and the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
verses.decoded: So the five kings of the Amorites—the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon—gathered together with all their armies, went up, camped in front of Gibeon, and attacked it.

verses.kjv: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
verses.decoded: The men of Gibeon sent a message to Joshua at the camp in Gilgal, saying, Do not stop helping your servants; come quickly to us, save us, and help us, because all the kings of the Amorites living in the mountains have gathered together against us.

verses.kjv: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
