verses.decoded: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the soldiers with him, and all the brave warriors.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not be afraid of them, because I have given them into your hand; not one of them will be able to stand against you.

verses.kjv: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
verses.decoded: So Joshua came to them suddenly and traveled all night from Gilgal.

verses.kjv: And the Lord discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
verses.decoded: And the LORD defeated them in front of Israel, and killed many of them at Gibeon, and chased them along the road that goes up to Beth-horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the Lord cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
verses.decoded: It happened that as they fled from Israel and were going down to Beth-horon, the LORD threw large stones from the sky on them all the way to Azekah, and they died. More people died from the hailstones than those the Israelites killed with the sword.

verses.kjv: Then spake Joshua to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
verses.decoded: Then Joshua spoke to the LORD on the day when the LORD handed the Amorites over to the Israelites, and he said in front of all Israel, Sun, stop moving over Gibeon; and you, Moon, stop in the valley of Ajalon.

verses.kjv: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
verses.decoded: The sun stopped moving, and the moon stopped too, until the people had taken revenge on their enemies. Isn't this recorded in the book of Jasher? So the sun stayed in the middle of the sky and did not hurry to set for about a whole day.

verses.kjv: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the Lord hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the Lord fought for Israel.
verses.decoded: There was no day like that before it or after it, when the LORD listened to the voice of a man, because the LORD fought for Israel.

verses.kjv: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.decoded: Joshua went back, and all of Israel went with him, to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.kjv: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.decoded: But these five kings ran away and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.kjv: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.decoded: Someone told Joshua, saying, The five kings are hiding in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
verses.decoded: And Joshua said, Roll large stones over the entrance of the cave, and place men there to guard it:

verses.kjv: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the Lord your God hath delivered them into your hand.
verses.decoded: Do not stop, but chase after your enemies, and strike the ones who are lagging behind; do not allow them to enter their cities, because the LORD your God has given them into your hand.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
verses.decoded: It happened that when Joshua and the Israelites finished killing them with a very large slaughter until they were completely destroyed, the rest who survived went into fortified cities.

verses.kjv: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: All the people went back to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah safely; no one spoke against any of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
verses.decoded: Then Joshua said, Open the entrance of the cave, and bring those five kings out to me from the cave.

verses.kjv: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.decoded: They did as he commanded and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
verses.decoded: When they brought those kings to Joshua, Joshua called all the men of Israel and said to the commanders of the soldiers who were with him, "Come here, place your feet on the necks of these kings." They came near and placed their feet on the necks of the kings.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to them, Do not be afraid or discouraged; be strong and courageous, because the LORD will do this to all your enemies you fight against.

verses.kjv: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
verses.decoded: After that, Joshua struck them down and killed them, and hung them on five trees. They stayed hanging on the trees until evening.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day.
verses.decoded: When the sun was setting, Joshua gave the order, and they took them down from the trees, threw them into the cave where they had been hiding, and placed large stones at the entrance of the cave, which are still there today.

verses.kjv: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.decoded: On that day Joshua captured Makkedah and struck it down with the sword, completely destroying its king and all the people inside; he left no one alive. He treated the king of Makkedah the same way he treated the king of Jericho.

verses.kjv: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
verses.decoded: Then Joshua left Makkedah, and all Israel went with him, to Libnah, and they fought against Libnah.

verses.kjv: And the Lord delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.decoded: And the LORD gave it, along with its king, into the hands of Israel; and they struck it down with the sword, killing everyone inside; they left no one alive; they treated its king the same way they treated the king of Jericho.

verses.kjv: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.decoded: Joshua left Libnah, and all Israel went with him to Lachish. They set up camp near it and fought against it.

verses.kjv: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.decoded: The LORD gave Lachish into the hands of Israel, who captured it on the second day, killed everyone there with the sword, just as they had done to Libnah.

verses.kjv: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.decoded: Then Horam, king of Gezer, came to help Lachish; and Joshua defeated him and his people, leaving none of them alive.

verses.kjv: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.decoded: And from Lachish, Joshua went to Eglon, with all Israel following him; they set up camp against it and fought against it.

verses.kjv: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.decoded: They captured it that day and killed everyone inside with the sword, completely destroying all the people there, just as they had done to Lachish.

verses.kjv: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.decoded: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all of Israel went with him to Hebron; and they fought against it.

verses.kjv: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
verses.decoded: They captured it and struck it down with the sword, including its king, all its cities, and everyone living there; he left no one alive, just as he had done to Eglon; he completely destroyed it and all the people living there.

verses.kjv: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
verses.decoded: Joshua went back, and all of Israel went with him, to Debir; and they fought against it:

verses.kjv: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
verses.decoded: He captured it, along with its king and all its cities; they killed them with the sword and completely destroyed everyone there; he left no one alive. Just as he had done to Hebron, he did the same to Debir and its king; he also did the same to Libnah and its king.

verses.kjv: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.
verses.decoded: So Joshua defeated all the land of the hills, the south, the valley, and the springs, along with all their kings; he left no one alive but completely destroyed everyone who was alive, just as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

verses.kjv: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.decoded: And Joshua defeated them from Kadesh-barnea all the way to Gaza, and throughout the entire region of Goshen, reaching as far as Gibeon.

verses.kjv: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.decoded: Joshua captured all these kings and their land at once because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

verses.kjv: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.decoded: Joshua returned, and all of Israel went with him, to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.decoded: When Jabin, king of Hazor, heard about these things, he sent messengers to Jobab, king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

verses.kjv: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
verses.decoded: And to the kings who were north of the mountains, and on the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and along the borders of Dor on the west,

verses.kjv: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
verses.decoded: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

verses.kjv: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
verses.decoded: They went out, they and all their armies with them, a large number of people, as many as the sand on the seashore, with many horses and chariots.

verses.kjv: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
verses.decoded: When all these kings gathered together, they came and camped together by the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow about this time I will hand them all over, killed in front of Israel. You will disable their horses by cutting their tendons and burn their chariots with fire.

verses.kjv: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
verses.decoded: So Joshua came, and all the soldiers with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they attacked them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
verses.decoded: And the LORD gave them into the hands of Israel, who defeated them and chased them as far as great Zidon, and Misrephoth-maim, and the valley of Mizpeh to the east; and they defeated them until they left none alive.

verses.kjv: And Joshua did unto them as the Lord bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.decoded: And Joshua did to them as the LORD commanded him: he cut the tendons of their horses' legs, and burned their chariots with fire.

verses.kjv: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.decoded: At that time, Joshua turned back, captured Hazor, and killed its king with the sword, because Hazor was previously the leader of all those kingdoms.

verses.kjv: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
verses.decoded: They killed every person there with the sword, completely destroying them; no one was left alive. Then he burned Hazor with fire.

verses.kjv: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.
verses.decoded: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings and all their kings, and he killed them with the sword, completely destroying them, just as Moses, the servant of the LORD, had commanded.

verses.kjv: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
verses.decoded: But regarding the cities that remained strong, Israel did not burn any of them except Hazor; Joshua burned only that city.

verses.kjv: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
verses.decoded: The children of Israel took all the loot from these cities and the cattle as their own; but they killed every man with the sword until they destroyed them completely, leaving no one alive.

verses.kjv: As the Lord commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: Just as the LORD commanded Moses his servant, Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did the same; he did not leave anything undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
verses.decoded: So Joshua took all that land, including the hills, all the southern region, all the land of Goshen, the valley, the plain, the mountain region of Israel, and the valley in that area.

verses.kjv: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
verses.decoded: From Mount Halak, which goes up to Seir, all the way to Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon beneath Mount Hermon: he captured all their kings, defeated them, and killed them.

verses.kjv: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.decoded: Joshua fought against all those kings for a long time.

verses.kjv: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
verses.decoded: There was no city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites who lived in Gibeon; they captured all the others in battle.

verses.kjv: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: Because the LORD caused their hearts to become stubborn so they would come to fight against Israel in battle, allowing Him to completely destroy them, so that they would not receive any mercy, and so that He could destroy them as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
verses.decoded: At that time, Joshua came and completely destroyed the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel. Joshua wiped them out completely along with their cities.

verses.kjv: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
verses.decoded: No Anakims were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did some remain.

verses.kjv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
verses.decoded: So Joshua took the entire land, just as the LORD had told Moses. Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. The land then had peace and was free from war.

verses.kjv: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
verses.decoded: These are the kings of the land whom the children of Israel defeated and took possession of their land on the other side of the Jordan River, toward the east, from the Arnon River to Mount Hermon, including all the plain on the east.

verses.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.decoded: Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half of Gilead, all the way to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the people of Ammon;

verses.kjv: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:
verses.decoded: And from the plain to the Sea of Chinneroth on the east, and to the Sea of the Plain, which is the Salt Sea on the east, the road to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, below Ashdoth-pisgah:

verses.kjv: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.decoded: And the territory of Og, king of Bashan, who was one of the remaining giants, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

verses.kjv: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.decoded: And he ruled on Mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and throughout all Bashan, up to the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half of Gilead, which was the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.kjv: Them did Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the Lord gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.decoded: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the children of Israel defeated them; and Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave that land as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.decoded: These are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites defeated on this side of the Jordan River to the west, from Baal-gad in the Lebanon Valley all the way to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir; Joshua gave this land to the tribes of Israel as their inheritance according to their divisions.

verses.kjv: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.decoded: In the mountains, in the valleys, in the plains, in the springs, in the wilderness, and in the southern land; the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

verses.kjv: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
verses.decoded: The king of Dor on the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

verses.kjv: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
verses.decoded: The king of Tirzah, one; all the kings, thirty-one.

verses.kjv: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the Lord said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
verses.decoded: Now Joshua was old and advanced in years; and the LORD said to him, You are old and advanced in years, and there is still a lot of land left to be taken possession of.

verses.kjv: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
verses.decoded: This is the land that still remains: all the territory of the Philistines, and all of Geshur,

verses.kjv: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
verses.decoded: From the Sihor River, which is near Egypt, up to the northern borders of Ekron, which belongs to the Canaanites: there were five rulers of the Philistines—the Gazathites, the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites—and also the Avites.

verses.kjv: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
verses.decoded: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah which is next to the Sidonians, up to Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:

verses.kjv: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
verses.decoded: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

verses.kjv: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.decoded: I will drive out all the people living in the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, from before the children of Israel. Just divide the land by lot among the Israelites as I have commanded you.

verses.kjv: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.decoded: Now, therefore, divide this land as an inheritance for the nine tribes and the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them;
verses.decoded: The Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance from them, which Moses gave to them beyond the Jordan River to the east, just as Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave it to them.

verses.kjv: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.decoded: From Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the river, and all the plain of Medeba up to Dibon;

verses.kjv: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.decoded: And all the cities of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, up to the border of the people of Ammon;

verses.kjv: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.decoded: And Gilead, and the territory of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all of Mount Hermon, and all of Bashan up to Salcah;

verses.kjv: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
verses.decoded: The entire kingdom of Og in Bashan, who ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei, was left as a remnant of the giants; Moses defeated them and drove them out.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
verses.decoded: However, the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maachathites; instead, the Geshurites and the Maachathites live among the Israelites to this day.

verses.kjv: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.decoded: He gave no land inheritance to the tribe of Levi; the offerings made by fire to the LORD God of Israel are their inheritance, as he told them.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
verses.decoded: And Moses gave the tribe of the children of Reuben their inheritance according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.decoded: Their territory stretched from Aroer, which is on the bank of the Arnon River, including the city located in the middle of the river, and all the plain near Medeba;

verses.kjv: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
verses.decoded: Heshbon, and all its cities in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

verses.kjv: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.decoded: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

verses.kjv: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.decoded: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mountain of the valley,

verses.kjv: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.decoded: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

verses.kjv: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.decoded: And all the cities of the plain, and the entire kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, whom Moses defeated along with the leaders of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, who were the chiefs of Sihon, living in the land.

verses.kjv: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.decoded: Balaam, the son of Beor, the fortune-teller, was also killed by the Israelites with the sword among those they killed.

verses.kjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.decoded: The boundary of the descendants of Reuben was the Jordan River and its boundary. This was the inheritance of the descendants of Reuben according to their families, including the cities and their villages.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.decoded: Moses gave the land as an inheritance to the tribe of Gad, specifically to the descendants of Gad according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.decoded: Their territory included Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the descendants of Ammon, up to Aroer which is in front of Rabbah;

verses.kjv: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.decoded: And from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

verses.kjv: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.decoded: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth on the other side of the Jordan to the east.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.decoded: This is the land that the descendants of Gad received as their inheritance, divided by their families, including the cities and their villages.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.decoded: And Moses gave land as an inheritance to the half tribe of Manasseh; this was the land owned by the half tribe of the children of Manasseh, divided by their families.

verses.kjv: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.decoded: Their territory stretched from Mahanaim, including all of Bashan, the entire kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair located in Bashan, totaling sixty cities.

verses.kjv: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.decoded: And half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, belonged to the descendants of Machir, the son of Manasseh, even to half of the descendants of Machir according to their families.

verses.kjv: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.decoded: These are the lands that Moses gave as inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side of the Jordan River, near Jericho, to the east.

verses.kjv: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.decoded: But Moses did not give any land to the tribe of Levi: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he told them.

verses.kjv: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
verses.decoded: These are the territories that the Israelites received as their inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders of the families of the Israelite tribes divided among them as their inheritance.

verses.kjv: By lot was their inheritance, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
verses.decoded: Their inheritance was determined by casting lots, as the LORD commanded through Moses, for the nine tribes and the half tribe.

verses.kjv: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
verses.decoded: Moses gave the land as an inheritance to two and a half tribes on the other side of the Jordan River, but he did not give any land inheritance to the Levites among them.

verses.kjv: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
verses.decoded: Because the descendants of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, they did not give any land to the Levites except for cities to live in, along with the surrounding pasturelands for their livestock and their livelihood.

verses.kjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.decoded: Just as the LORD commanded Moses, the children of Israel obeyed and divided the land.

verses.kjv: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the Lord said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.
verses.decoded: Then the people of Judah came to Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, said to him, You know what the LORD said to Moses, the man of God, about me and you at Kadesh-barnea.

verses.kjv: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
verses.decoded: I was forty years old when Moses, the servant of the LORD, sent me from Kadesh-barnea to explore the land; and I reported back to him exactly what was in my heart.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.decoded: However, my brothers who went up with me caused the people to lose courage, but I completely followed the LORD my God.

verses.kjv: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.decoded: And Moses swore on that day, saying, Surely the land where your feet have walked will be your inheritance, and your children’s forever, because you have completely followed the LORD my God.

verses.kjv: And now, behold, the Lord hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the Lord spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.decoded: And now, look, the LORD has kept me alive, just as he said, for these forty-five years, ever since the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while the children of Israel were wandering in the wilderness; and now, look, I am this day eighty-five years old.

verses.kjv: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.decoded: I am still as strong today as I was on the day Moses sent me; my strength then is the same as my strength now, both for going out to battle and coming back.

verses.kjv: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the Lord spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the Lord will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the Lord said.
verses.decoded: So now, give me this mountain that the LORD spoke about that day; because you heard that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were large and fortified: if the LORD is with me, then I will be able to drive them out, just as the LORD said.

verses.kjv: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
verses.decoded: And Joshua blessed him and gave Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, Hebron as his inheritance.

verses.kjv: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: Hebron then became the inheritance of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, up to this day, because he completely followed the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
verses.decoded: The city of Hebron was formerly called Kirjath-arba, because Arba was a prominent man among the Anakims. The land then experienced peace and was free from war.
This was the land assigned to the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; the southernmost part of their territory was the wilderness of Zin, reaching to the border of Edom.

verses.kjv: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
verses.decoded: Their southern boundary started at the shore of the Salt Sea, at the bay that faces south.

verses.kjv: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
verses.decoded: It went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, then passed along to Zin, and went up on the south side to Kadesh-barnea, then passed along to Hezron, went up to Adar, and made a turn to Karkaa:

verses.kjv: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
verses.decoded: From there it went toward Azmon and reached the river of Egypt; the border of that area ended at the sea: this will be your southern border.

verses.kjv: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
verses.decoded: The eastern border was the Dead Sea, extending all the way to the end of the Jordan River. Their northern border was from the bay of the sea at the farthest part of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.decoded: And the boundary went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along to the north of Beth-arabah; and the boundary went up to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben:

verses.kjv: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:
verses.decoded: The boundary went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, then northward, facing Gilgal, which is before the ascent to Adummim, located on the south side of the river; and the boundary extended toward the waters of En-shemesh, with its outlets at En-rogel.

verses.kjv: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
verses.decoded: And the boundary went up along the valley of the son of Hinnom to the southern side of the Jebusite, which is Jerusalem; and the boundary went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom on the west side, which is at the end of the valley of the giants to the north.

verses.kjv: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim:
verses.decoded: The boundary was drawn from the top of the hill to the spring of the water of Nephtoah, then extended to the towns of Mount Ephron; and the boundary was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim.

verses.kjv: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.decoded: The boundary went from Baalah west toward Mount Seir, then continued to the side of Mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, then went down to Beth-shemesh, and continued on to Timnah.

verses.kjv: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.decoded: The boundary extended to the area of Ekron on the north side; the boundary was drawn to Shicron, then passed along to Mount Baalah, and extended to Jabneel; the boundary ended at the sea.

verses.kjv: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.decoded: The western boundary was the Great Sea and its shoreline. This is the territory of the descendants of Judah all around, divided according to their families.

verses.kjv: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
verses.decoded: And to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, he gave a portion among the people of Judah, following the LORD's command to Joshua, which was the city of Arba, the father of Anak, that city is Hebron.

verses.kjv: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.decoded: And Caleb forced out from there the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, who were the children of Anak.

verses.kjv: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.
verses.decoded: And he went up from there to the people living in Debir; and Debir was previously called Kirjath-sepher.

verses.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.decoded: And Caleb said, Whoever attacks Kirjath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Achsah to him as a wife.

verses.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.decoded: And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, who was Caleb's brother, captured it; and he gave him Achsah, his daughter, as a wife.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.decoded: When she came to him, she persuaded him to ask her father for a field. She got down from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"

verses.kjv: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
verses.decoded: She answered, "Give me a blessing, because you have given me a southern land; also give me some springs of water." And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.decoded: This is the land given to the tribe of the descendants of Judah, divided according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.decoded: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom to the south were Kabzeel, Eder, and Jagur,

verses.kjv: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.decoded: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

verses.kjv: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.decoded: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

verses.kjv: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.decoded: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

verses.kjv: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
verses.decoded: And Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, and Hezron, which is also called Hazor,

verses.kjv: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.decoded: Amam, Shema, and Moladah,

verses.kjv: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,
verses.decoded: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

verses.kjv: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.decoded: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

verses.kjv: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
verses.decoded: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

verses.kjv: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.decoded: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

verses.kjv: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.decoded: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

verses.kjv: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
verses.decoded: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

verses.kjv: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
verses.decoded: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

verses.kjv: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.decoded: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

verses.kjv: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.decoded: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

verses.kjv: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,
verses.decoded: Zenan, Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

verses.kjv: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.decoded: Dilean, Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

verses.kjv: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.decoded: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

verses.kjv: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.decoded: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

verses.kjv: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.decoded: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

verses.kjv: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.decoded: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

verses.kjv: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
verses.decoded: Ekron, along with its towns and villages:

verses.kjv: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
verses.decoded: From Ekron all the way to the sea, including all the areas near Ashdod and their villages:

verses.kjv: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
verses.decoded: Ashdod with its towns and its villages, Gaza with its towns and its villages, up to the river of Egypt, the great sea, and its border:

verses.kjv: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.decoded: And in the mountains, Shamir, Jattir, and Socoh,

verses.kjv: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,
verses.decoded: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is called Debir,

verses.kjv: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.decoded: Anab, Eshtemoh, and Anim,

verses.kjv: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
verses.decoded: Arab, Dumah, and Eshean,

verses.kjv: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,
verses.decoded: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

verses.kjv: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
verses.decoded: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, and Juttah,

verses.kjv: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.decoded: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

verses.kjv: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,
verses.decoded: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

verses.kjv: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.decoded: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

verses.kjv: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.decoded: Regarding the Jebusites, the people living in Jerusalem, the descendants of Judah were not able to force them out; instead, the Jebusites live together with the descendants of Judah in Jerusalem up to the present time.

verses.kjv: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el,
verses.decoded: The land assigned to the descendants of Joseph stretched from the Jordan River near Jericho to the spring of Jericho on the east, extending to the wilderness that rises from Jericho up to Mount Bethel.

verses.kjv: And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
verses.decoded: And it goes out from Bethel to Luz, and continues along to the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

verses.kjv: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
verses.decoded: And it goes down westward to the border of Japhleti, to the border of Lower Beth-horon, and to Gezer; and its boundary ends at the sea.

verses.kjv: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.decoded: So the descendants of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.

verses.kjv: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;
verses.decoded: The boundary of the descendants of Ephraim according to their families was as follows: the eastern boundary of their inheritance was Ataroth-addar, extending to Upper Beth-horon.

verses.kjv: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
verses.decoded: The boundary extended toward the sea up to Michmethah on the north side; then the boundary turned eastward to Taanath-shiloh, passing east of it to Janohah;

verses.kjv: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
verses.decoded: It went down from Janohah to Ataroth, then to Naarath, reached Jericho, and continued out to the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
verses.decoded: The boundary extended from Tappuah westward to the Kanah River; and its outlets reached the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants of Ephraim, divided by their families.

verses.kjv: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: The cities set apart for the descendants of Ephraim were within the territory inherited by the descendants of Manasseh, including all the cities and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
verses.decoded: And they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; instead, the Canaanites live among the Ephraimites to this day and pay tribute.

verses.kjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.decoded: There was also a territory assigned to the tribe of Manasseh because he was the firstborn son of Joseph; specifically, for Machir, the firstborn son of Manasseh, who was the father of Gilead: because he was a warrior, he received Gilead and Bashan.

verses.kjv: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
verses.decoded: There was also a land allotment for the rest of the descendants of Manasseh by their family groups; for the descendants of Abiezer, and for the descendants of Helek, and for the descendants of Asriel, and for the descendants of Shechem, and for the descendants of Hepher, and for the descendants of Shemida: these were the male descendants of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, organized by their families.

verses.kjv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.decoded: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, only daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.decoded: They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our relatives. So, following the LORD's command, he gave them an inheritance among their father's relatives.

verses.kjv: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
verses.decoded: Ten portions were given to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side of the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.decoded: Because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance alongside his sons, and the other sons of Manasseh received the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
verses.decoded: The territory of Manasseh stretched from Asher to Michmethah, which is located in front of Shechem; and the border extended on the right side up to the people living in En-tappuah.

verses.kjv: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
verses.decoded: Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the descendants of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
verses.decoded: The boundary went down to the Kanah River, which is south of the river; these cities of Ephraim are located among the cities of Manasseh. The boundary of Manasseh was also on the north side of the river, and its borders extended to the sea.

verses.kjv: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
verses.decoded: To the south was Ephraim’s land, to the north was Manasseh’s land, and the sea was its border; they met together at Asher on the north, and at Issachar on the east.

verses.kjv: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
verses.decoded: Manasseh controlled Beth-shean and its towns in Issachar and Asher, Ibleam and its towns, the people of Dor and its towns, the people of Endor and its towns, the people of Taanach and its towns, and the people of Megiddo and its towns, covering three regions.

verses.kjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.decoded: However, the descendants of Manasseh were not able to force out the people living in those cities; instead, the Canaanites continued to live in that land.

verses.kjv: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.decoded: But it happened that when the Israelites became strong, they forced the Canaanites to pay tribute; however, they did not completely drive them out.

verses.kjv: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the Lord hath blessed me hitherto?
verses.decoded: And the descendants of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, Why have you given me only one share and one portion to inherit, since I am a large group of people, because the LORD has blessed me up to this time?

verses.kjv: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
verses.decoded: And Joshua answered them, If you are a large group of people, then go up to the forest area and clear land for yourself there in the territory of the Perizzites and the giants, if Mount Ephraim is too small for you.

verses.kjv: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Joseph said, The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites living in the valley have iron chariots, both those from Beth-shean and its towns, and those from the valley of Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.decoded: And Joshua spoke to the family of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, saying, You are a large people with great strength; you will not receive only one portion of land.

verses.kjv: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
verses.decoded: But the mountain will belong to you because it is covered with forest, and you will cut it down; and the areas around it will belong to you because you will drive out the Canaanites, even though they have iron chariots and are strong.

verses.kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.decoded: All the people of Israel gathered together at Shiloh and set up the meeting tent there. The land was brought under their control.

verses.kjv: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.decoded: Seven tribes were still among the children of Israel who had not yet received their land.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, How long will you delay going to take possession of the land that the LORD God of your ancestors has given you?

verses.kjv: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
verses.decoded: Choose three men from each tribe among you, and I will send them out. They will get up, go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of each tribe; then they will return to me.

verses.kjv: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
verses.decoded: They will divide it into seven parts: Judah will live in their territory in the south, and the family of Joseph will live in their territories in the north.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
verses.decoded: You shall therefore divide the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me, so that I can cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
verses.decoded: But the Levites do not have a portion of land among you because the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and half of the tribe of Manasseh have received their land inheritance on the east side of the Jordan River, which Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave to them.

verses.kjv: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.
verses.decoded: The men got up and left, and Joshua gave instructions to those who were going to survey the land, saying, 'Go and walk through the land, map it out, and come back to me so that I can cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.'

verses.kjv: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
verses.decoded: The men went through the land, mapping it out by cities into seven sections in a book, and then returned to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.

verses.kjv: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.decoded: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD, and there Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their groups.

verses.kjv: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.decoded: The land assigned to the tribe of the children of Benjamin was determined by their families, and the boundary of their land was located between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

verses.kjv: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.decoded: Their northern border started at the Jordan River; the border went up to the northern side of Jericho, then continued westward through the mountains; its boundary ended at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

verses.kjv: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Beth-el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.
verses.decoded: And the boundary went from there toward Luz, to the area of Luz, which is Bethel, to the south; and the boundary went down to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that is on the south side of Lower Beth-horon.

verses.kjv: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
verses.decoded: Then the boundary was drawn from there, surrounding the corner of the sea to the south, starting from the hill that lies in front of Beth-horon to the south; and its exits were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the descendants of Judah: this was the western part.

verses.kjv: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
verses.decoded: The southern boundary started at the end of Kirjath-jearim, then the border extended westward until it reached the well of the waters of Nephtoah.

verses.kjv: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,
verses.decoded: And the boundary went down to the end of the mountain that lies in front of the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and went down to the valley of Hinnom, next to Jebusi on the south, and went down to En-rogel,

verses.kjv: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.decoded: It extended from the north and went out to En-shemesh, then went toward Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, and went down to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben.

verses.kjv: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
verses.decoded: And traveled along the side facing Arabah to the north, and went down into Arabah:

verses.kjv: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
verses.decoded: And the boundary went along the side of Beth-hoglah to the north; and the boundary's end was at the northern bay of the Salt Sea at the southern end of the Jordan River; this was the southern border.

verses.kjv: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.decoded: The Jordan River was its eastern boundary. This was the land inherited by the descendants of Benjamin, with its borders all around, divided according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.decoded: The cities of the tribe of Benjamin, organized by their families, were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

verses.kjv: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,
verses.decoded: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

verses.kjv: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
verses.decoded: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

verses.kjv: And Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.decoded: Chephar-haammonai, Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.decoded: Gibeon, Ramah, and Beeroth,

verses.kjv: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
verses.decoded: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

verses.kjv: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.decoded: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

verses.kjv: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.decoded: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their surrounding villages. This is the inheritance of the descendants of Benjamin according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.decoded: The second lot was given to Simeon, to the tribe of the descendants of Simeon according to their families, and their inheritance was inside the territory of the descendants of Judah.

verses.kjv: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.decoded: They had Beer-sheba, also called Sheba, and Moladah in their inheritance,

verses.kjv: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,
verses.decoded: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

verses.kjv: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.decoded: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

verses.kjv: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,
verses.decoded: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

verses.kjv: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.decoded: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.decoded: Ain, Remmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.decoded: And all the villages surrounding these cities up to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the descendants of Simeon according to their families.

verses.kjv: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
verses.decoded: The children of Simeon received their inheritance from the portion of the children of Judah because Judah's share was too large for them. Therefore, the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the land that belonged to Judah.

verses.kjv: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
verses.decoded: The third portion was assigned to the descendants of Zebulun according to their family groups, and the boundary of their land went as far as Sarid.

verses.kjv: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
verses.decoded: Their boundary went up toward the sea, including Maralah, extended to Dabbasheth, and reached the river in front of Jokneam;

verses.kjv: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
verses.decoded: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth-tabor, then goes out to Daberath, and goes up to Japhia,

verses.kjv: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;
verses.decoded: And from there it goes east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and continues to Remmon-methoar to Neah;

verses.kjv: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:
verses.decoded: And the border surrounds it on the north side up to Hannathon, and its boundaries extend to the valley of Jiphthah-el.

verses.kjv: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.
