verses.decoded: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: This is the land that the descendants of Zebulun received as their inheritance, divided according to their family groups, including these cities and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.decoded: The fourth portion was given to Issachar, to the descendants of Issachar according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.decoded: Their boundary was next to Jezreel, Chesulloth, and Shunem,

verses.kjv: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
verses.decoded: And Haphraim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,

verses.kjv: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
verses.decoded: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

verses.kjv: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;
verses.decoded: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

verses.kjv: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: The boundary extends to Tabor, Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the edges of their territory reached the Jordan River: sixteen cities with their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.decoded: This is the land given to the tribe of the descendants of Issachar, divided according to their family groups, including the cities and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.decoded: The fifth portion was assigned to the tribe of the children of Asher according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.decoded: Their boundary included Helkath, Hali, Beten, and Achshaph,

verses.kjv: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;
verses.decoded: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and it reaches to Carmel on the west, and to Shihor-libnath;

verses.kjv: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.decoded: And it turns toward the east to Beth-dagon, and reaches Zebulun, and the valley of Jiphthah-el on the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goes out to Cabul on the left side,

verses.kjv: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
verses.decoded: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, up to great Zidon;

verses.kjv: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
verses.decoded: Then the boundary turns to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; then the boundary turns to Hosah; and its borders reach the sea from the boundary to Achzib.

verses.kjv: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: This is the land given to the tribe of the descendants of Asher, divided according to their family groups, including these cities and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.decoded: The sixth portion was given to the descendants of Naphtali, specifically to the descendants of Naphtali according to their family groups.

verses.kjv: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
verses.decoded: Their boundary went from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, up to Lakum; and its borders extended to the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.decoded: Then the boundary turns west to Aznoth-tabor, and goes from there to Hukkok, reaching Zebulun on the south side, reaching Asher on the west side, and reaching Judah by the Jordan River toward the east.

verses.kjv: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
verses.decoded: The walled cities are Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth.

verses.kjv: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
verses.decoded: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

verses.kjv: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,
verses.decoded: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

verses.kjv: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.decoded: This is the land given to the tribe of Naphtali's descendants, divided according to their family groups, including the cities and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.decoded: The seventh portion was assigned to the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

verses.kjv: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,
verses.decoded: The boundary of their inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

verses.kjv: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
verses.decoded: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

verses.kjv: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
verses.decoded: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,

verses.kjv: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
verses.decoded: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

verses.kjv: And Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,
verses.decoded: And Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

verses.kjv: And Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
verses.decoded: And Me-jarkon and Rakkon, along with the border in front of Japho.

verses.kjv: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.decoded: The territory of the children of Dan was too small for them, so the children of Dan went to fight against Leshem, captured it, killed its people with the sword, took control of it, lived there, and renamed Leshem to Dan, after the name of their ancestor Dan.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.decoded: This is the land given to the tribe of the descendants of Dan, divided according to their family groups, including these cities and their surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
verses.decoded: After they finished dividing the land for inheritance according to their borders, the Israelites gave an inheritance to Joshua son of Nun among them:

verses.kjv: According to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
verses.decoded: Following the command of the LORD, they gave him the city he requested, which was Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. He built the city and lived there.

verses.kjv: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
verses.decoded: These are the land portions that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders of the families of the tribes of Israel divided by casting lots in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD, at the entrance of the meeting tent. Then they finished dividing the land.

verses.kjv: The Lord also spake unto Joshua, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD also spoke to Joshua, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel, 'Set aside cities of refuge for yourselves, which I told you about through Moses.'

verses.kjv: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.decoded: So that the person who kills someone accidentally and without intention can escape there; and those places will be your protection from the person seeking revenge for bloodshed.

verses.kjv: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
verses.decoded: When someone flees to one of those cities and stands at the city gate, explaining their case to the elders of that city, the elders will bring them into the city and give them a place to live among them.

verses.kjv: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
verses.decoded: And if the person seeking to kill him pursues him, they will not hand the killer over to him because he struck his neighbor unintentionally and did not hate him previously.

verses.kjv: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
verses.decoded: And he will live in that city until he stands before the community for judgment, and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time; then the person who killed someone unintentionally will return and go to his own city and to his own house, to the city from which he fled.

verses.kjv: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.
verses.decoded: They set up Kedesh in Galilee on Mount Naphtali, Shechem on Mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, on the mountain of Judah.

verses.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.decoded: On the other side of the Jordan River, east of Jericho, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness on the plain from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
verses.decoded: These were the cities set apart for all the children of Israel and for the foreigner living among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally can flee there and not be killed by the avenger of blood until they stand before the community.

verses.kjv: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the families of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the leaders of the families of the tribes of the children of Israel;

verses.kjv: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
verses.decoded: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to live in, along with the surrounding lands for our livestock.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel gave the Levites these cities and their surrounding areas from their own land, following the LORD's command.

verses.kjv: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.decoded: The lot was drawn for the families of the Kohathites, and the descendants of Aaron the priest, who were Levites, received by lot thirteen cities from the tribe of Judah, the tribe of Simeon, and the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.decoded: The remaining descendants of Kohath received by lot ten cities from the families of the tribe of Ephraim, the tribe of Dan, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Gershon received by lot thirteen cities from the families of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

verses.kjv: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Merari, by their families, received twelve cities from the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel gave these cities and their surrounding areas to the Levites by casting lots, just as the LORD commanded through Moses.

verses.kjv: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
verses.decoded: They gave these cities, which are named here, from the tribe of the descendants of Judah and from the tribe of the descendants of Simeon.

verses.kjv: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Aaron, from the families of the Kohathites, who were part of the children of Levi, received these because their portion was the first to be assigned.

verses.kjv: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.decoded: They gave them the city of Arba, the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, located in the hill country of Judah, along with its surrounding suburbs.

verses.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.decoded: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as his property.

verses.kjv: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: So they gave to the descendants of Aaron the priest the city of Hebron with its surrounding areas, to serve as a city of refuge for someone who killed a person unintentionally; and Libnah with its surrounding areas,

verses.kjv: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And Jattir with its surrounding villages, and Eshtemoa with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And Holon with its surrounding areas, and Debir with its surrounding areas,

verses.kjv: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.decoded: And Ain with its surrounding areas, and Juttah with its surrounding areas, and Beth-shemesh with its surrounding areas; nine cities from those two tribes.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its surrounding villages, Geba with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.decoded: Anathoth with its surrounding villages, and Almon with its surrounding villages; four cities.

verses.kjv: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.decoded: All the cities given to the descendants of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities along with their surrounding areas.

verses.kjv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.decoded: The families of the descendants of Kohath, the Levites who were left from the descendants of Kohath, received their allotted cities from the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: They gave them Shechem with its surrounding areas in Mount Ephraim, to serve as a city of refuge for someone who killed a person unintentionally; and Gezer with its surrounding areas,

verses.kjv: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.decoded: And Kibzaim with its surrounding villages, and Beth-horon with its surrounding villages; four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with its surrounding villages, Gibbethon with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.decoded: Aijalon and its surrounding villages, Gath-rimmon and its surrounding villages; four cities in total.

verses.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.decoded: And from the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with its surrounding villages, and Gath-rimmon with its surrounding villages; two cities.

verses.kjv: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
verses.decoded: There were ten cities with their surrounding areas for the families of the descendants of Kohath who remained.

verses.kjv: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.decoded: And to the descendants of Gershon, from the families of the Levites, they gave from the other half tribe of Manasseh the city of Golan in Bashan with its surrounding towns, to be a city of refuge for someone who kills unintentionally; and Beesh-terah with its surrounding towns; two cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with its surrounding villages, Dabareh with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.decoded: Jarmuth with its surrounding villages, En-gannim with its surrounding villages; four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its surrounding villages, Abdon with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.decoded: Helkath and its surrounding areas, and Rehob and its surrounding areas; four cities in total.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its surrounding areas was given to be a city of refuge for someone who killed another person unintentionally; also Hammoth-dor with its surrounding areas, and Kartan with its surrounding areas; three cities in total.

verses.kjv: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.decoded: All the cities given to the Gershonites according to their family groups were thirteen cities with their surrounding areas.

verses.kjv: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And to the families of the descendants of Merari, the remaining Levites, from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its surrounding villages, and Kartah with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.decoded: Dimnah and its surrounding villages, Nahalal and its surrounding villages; four cities in total.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its surrounding villages, and Jahazah with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.decoded: Kedemoth and its surrounding areas, and Mephaath and its surrounding areas; four cities in total.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its surrounding areas, to be a city of refuge for someone who kills another unintentionally; and Mahanaim with its surrounding areas,

verses.kjv: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
verses.decoded: Heshbon with its surrounding villages, Jazer with its surrounding villages; four cities in total.

verses.kjv: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
verses.decoded: So all the cities for the descendants of Merari by their families, which were left from the families of the Levites, were assigned to them by their lot as twelve cities.

verses.kjv: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
verses.decoded: All the cities given to the Levites within the land owned by the Israelites were forty-eight cities along with their surrounding areas.

verses.kjv: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
verses.decoded: Each of these cities had their surrounding suburbs around them: this is how all these cities were.

verses.kjv: And the Lord gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
verses.decoded: And the LORD gave Israel all the land that he promised to give to their ancestors; and they took possession of it and lived there.

verses.kjv: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.decoded: And the LORD gave them peace all around, just as He had promised their ancestors: no enemy stood against them; the LORD handed all their enemies over to them.

verses.kjv: There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
verses.decoded: Nothing good that the LORD promised to the house of Israel failed; everything happened as He said.

verses.kjv: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.decoded: Then Joshua called the people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
verses.decoded: And said to them, You have kept all that Moses, the servant of the LORD, commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in everything that I commanded you:

verses.kjv: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.
verses.decoded: You have not abandoned your brothers all these days up to this day, but have obeyed the commandment of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: And now the Lord your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side Jordan.
verses.decoded: And now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as he promised them; so now return and go to your tents and to the land you own, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord charged you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.decoded: But be very careful to obey the command and the law that Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave you: to love the LORD your God, to follow all his ways, to keep his commandments, to stay close to him, and to serve him with all your heart and all your soul.

verses.kjv: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
verses.decoded: So Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their tents.

verses.kjv: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
verses.decoded: Now Moses gave one half of the tribe of Manasseh land to live in Bashan, but Joshua gave the other half among their relatives on this side of the Jordan River, to the west. After Joshua sent them back to their homes, he blessed them.

verses.kjv: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
verses.decoded: And he spoke to them, saying, Return with many riches to your tents, and with very many cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with bronze, and with iron, and with very many clothes: share the spoil of your enemies with your brothers.

verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Reuben, the descendants of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh returned and left the Israelites at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the region of Gilead, to the land they owned, which they had received, according to the LORD's command through Moses.

verses.kjv: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
verses.decoded: When they reached the borders of the Jordan River, which are in the land of Canaan, the descendants of Reuben, the descendants of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan River, a large altar that could be easily seen.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: The Israelites heard that the descendants of Reuben, the descendants of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh had built an altar opposite the land of Canaan, on the border of the Jordan River, at the crossing place of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
verses.decoded: When the people of Israel heard about it, the entire assembly of the people of Israel gathered at Shiloh to prepare to go to war against them.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.decoded: The Israelites sent Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, to the descendants of Reuben, the descendants of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
verses.decoded: And with him were ten leaders, one leader from each main family throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was the head of his family among the thousands of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
verses.decoded: They went to the descendants of Reuben, the descendants of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead, and they spoke to them, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the whole congregation of the Lord, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the Lord, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the Lord?
verses.decoded: This is what the entire assembly of the LORD says: What sin have you committed against the God of Israel by turning away today from following the LORD, by building an altar for yourselves to rebel against the LORD today?

verses.kjv: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord,
verses.decoded: Is the sin of Peor not enough for us, which we have not been cleansed from until today, even though there was a plague in the community of the LORD,

verses.kjv: But that ye must turn away this day from following the Lord? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the Lord, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.
verses.decoded: Are you going to turn away today from following the LORD? If you rebel against the LORD today, then tomorrow he will be angry with the entire community of Israel.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the Lord, wherein the Lord’s tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the Lord, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the Lord our God.
verses.decoded: However, if the land you own is unclean, then cross over to the land that belongs to the LORD, where the LORD’s tabernacle is located, and take possession among us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
verses.decoded: Did not Achan, the son of Zerah, sin by taking something that was under the ban, and anger came upon the entire community of Israel? And that man did not die alone because of his sin.

verses.kjv: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
verses.decoded: Then the descendants of Reuben, the descendants of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh answered and said to the leaders of the thousands of Israel,

verses.kjv: The Lord God of gods, the Lord God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, (save us not this day,)
verses.decoded: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knows, and Israel will know; if it is rebellion, or if it is sin against the LORD, (do not save us today,)

verses.kjv: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the Lord, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the Lord himself require it;
verses.decoded: That we have built an altar for ourselves to stop following the LORD, or if we are going to offer burnt offerings or grain offerings on it, or if we are going to offer peace offerings on it, let the LORD himself demand it;

verses.kjv: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the Lord God of Israel?
verses.decoded: And if we have not done this because we were afraid that in the future your children might say to our children, 'What do you have to do with the LORD God of Israel?'

verses.kjv: For the Lord hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the Lord: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the Lord.
verses.decoded: For the LORD has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad; you have no share in the LORD: so your children will cause our children to stop fearing the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
verses.decoded: So we said, Let us now get ready to build an altar for ourselves, not for burnt offerings or sacrifices:

verses.kjv: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the Lord before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the Lord.
verses.decoded: But let this be a witness between us and you and our future generations, that we may serve the LORD with our burnt offerings, sacrifices, and peace offerings. This is so that your children will not say to our children in the future, 'You have no share in the LORD.'

verses.kjv: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
verses.decoded: So we said that when they say this to us or to our descendants in the future, we can answer, 'Look at the design of the altar of the LORD, which our ancestors made. It was not made for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but it serves as a witness between us and you.'

verses.kjv: God forbid that we should rebel against the Lord, and turn this day from following the Lord, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the Lord our God that is before his tabernacle.
verses.decoded: May it never happen that we rebel against the LORD and stop following the LORD today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings, or sacrifices next to the altar of the LORD our God that is in front of his tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
verses.decoded: When Phinehas the priest, the leaders of the assembly, and the commanders of the thousands of Israel who were with him heard the words spoken by the descendants of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh, they were pleased.

verses.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the Lord is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the Lord: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, said to the children of Reuben, the children of Gad, and the children of Manasseh, "Today we realize that the LORD is among us because you have not committed this sin against the LORD. Now you have saved the children of Israel from the power of the LORD."

verses.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
verses.decoded: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, and the leaders returned from the descendants of Reuben and Gad, from the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the people of Israel, and reported back to them.

verses.kjv: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
verses.decoded: And this pleased the people of Israel; the people of Israel praised God and did not plan to fight against them to destroy the land where the descendants of Reuben and Gad lived.

verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the Lord is God.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Reuben and the descendants of Gad named the altar Ed because it will serve as a witness between us that the LORD is God.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass a long time after that the Lord had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.
verses.decoded: A long time after the LORD had given Israel rest from all their enemies around them, Joshua became old and advanced in years.

verses.kjv: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
verses.decoded: And Joshua called all Israel, including their elders, leaders, judges, and officials, and said to them, I am old and advanced in years:

verses.kjv: And ye have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the Lord your God is he that hath fought for you.
verses.decoded: And you have seen everything that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is the one who has fought for you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
verses.decoded: Look, I have given you these remaining nations by casting lots, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan River, along with all the nations I have destroyed, all the way to the great sea on the west.

verses.kjv: And the Lord your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the Lord your God hath promised unto you.
verses.decoded: And the LORD your God will force them out from in front of you, and push them away from your view; and you will take possession of their land, just as the LORD your God has promised you.

verses.kjv: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
verses.decoded: So be very brave to obey and do everything written in the book of the law of Moses, and do not turn away from it to the right or to the left;

verses.kjv: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
verses.decoded: Do not associate with these nations that still live among you; do not mention the names of their gods, do not swear by them, do not serve them, and do not bow down to them.

verses.kjv: But cleave unto the Lord your God, as ye have done unto this day.
verses.decoded: But remain closely devoted to the LORD your God, just as you have done up to this day.

verses.kjv: For the Lord hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
verses.decoded: For the LORD has driven out great and strong nations from before you, but no one has been able to stand against you until this day.

verses.kjv: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the Lord your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
verses.decoded: One man from you will chase a thousand, because the LORD your God is the one who fights for you, just as he promised you.

verses.kjv: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the Lord your God.
verses.decoded: Be very careful, then, to love the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
verses.decoded: But if you in any way turn back and join yourselves to the remaining people of these nations, those who still live among you, and marry them, and they marry you:

verses.kjv: Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.
verses.decoded: Be absolutely sure that the LORD your God will no longer remove any of these nations from before you; instead, they will become traps and dangers to you, punishments in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you are destroyed from this good land that the LORD your God has given you.

verses.kjv: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the Lord your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.
verses.decoded: And look, today I am going the way of everyone on earth: and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things that the LORD your God spoke about you; all have come true for you, and not one thing has failed.

verses.kjv: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the Lord your God promised you; so shall the Lord bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.
verses.decoded: So it will happen that just as all the good things the LORD your God promised you have come to you, the LORD will also bring all the bad things upon you until he has destroyed you from this good land that the LORD your God gave you.

verses.kjv: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
verses.decoded: When you have broken the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed down to them; then the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you, and you will quickly perish from the good land that he has given to you.

verses.kjv: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
verses.decoded: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel at Shechem and called for the elders of Israel, their leaders, their judges, and their officers; and they stood before God.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to all the people, This is what the LORD God of Israel says: Your ancestors lived on the other side of the Euphrates River long ago, including Terah, the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor, and they worshiped other gods.

verses.kjv: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
verses.decoded: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the Euphrates River, and led him through all the land of Canaan, and increased his descendants, and gave him Isaac.

verses.kjv: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
verses.decoded: And I gave Isaac Jacob and Esau; and I gave Esau Mount Seir to live in; but Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.

verses.kjv: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.decoded: I sent Moses and Aaron, and I caused plagues in Egypt, just as I did among them; and afterward I brought you out.

verses.kjv: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
verses.decoded: And I brought your ancestors out of Egypt; and you came to the sea; and the Egyptians chased after your ancestors with chariots and horsemen to the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: And when they cried unto the Lord, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
verses.decoded: And when they cried out to the LORD, he caused darkness to come between you and the Egyptians, and he brought the sea over them and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and you lived in the wilderness for a long time.

verses.kjv: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.decoded: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, who lived on the other side of the Jordan; and they fought against you, but I gave them into your hands so that you could take possession of their land; and I destroyed them in front of you.

verses.kjv: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
verses.decoded: Then Balak, the son of Zippor, king of Moab, got up and fought against Israel, and sent for Balaam, the son of Beor, to curse you.

verses.kjv: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
verses.decoded: But I did not listen to Balaam; therefore he continued to bless you. So I saved you from his power.

verses.kjv: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.decoded: And you crossed the Jordan River and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, along with the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. I handed them over to you.

verses.kjv: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
verses.decoded: And I sent the hornet ahead of you, which forced them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with your sword, nor with your bow.

verses.kjv: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
verses.decoded: And I have given you a land that you did not work for, and cities that you did not build, and you live in them; you eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.

verses.kjv: Now therefore fear the Lord, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the Lord.
verses.decoded: So now, respect the LORD and serve him honestly and truthfully. Get rid of the gods that your ancestors worshiped on the other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt. Serve the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.
verses.decoded: And if it seems wrong to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods your ancestors served on the other side of the river, or the gods of the Amorites, whose land you are living in. But as for me and my family, we will serve the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the Lord, to serve other gods;
verses.decoded: And the people answered and said, May it never happen that we abandon the LORD to serve other gods;

verses.kjv: For the Lord our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
verses.decoded: For the LORD our God is the one who brought us and our ancestors out of Egypt, from the place of slavery, who performed those great miracles in front of us, and protected us throughout the entire journey we took, and among all the nations we traveled through.

verses.kjv: And the Lord drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the Lord; for he is our God.
verses.decoded: And the LORD drove out all the people from before us, including the Amorites who lived in the land; so we will also serve the LORD because he is our God.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the Lord: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to the people, You cannot serve the LORD, because he is a holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your rebellions or your sins.

verses.kjv: If ye forsake the Lord, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
verses.decoded: If you abandon the LORD and worship other gods, then he will turn against you and harm you, destroying you after he has done good for you.

verses.kjv: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the Lord.
verses.decoded: And the people said to Joshua, No; but we will serve the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the Lord, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

verses.kjv: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: So now, he said, get rid of the foreign gods that are among you, and turn your heart to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the people said unto Joshua, The Lord our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
verses.decoded: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the LORD our God, and we will obey his voice.

verses.kjv: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.decoded: So Joshua made an agreement with the people that day, and established a law and a rule for them in Shechem.

verses.kjv: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a large stone, and placed it there under an oak tree near the LORD's sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the Lord which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
verses.decoded: And Joshua said to all the people, Look, this stone will be a witness for us because it has heard all the words of the LORD that he spoke to us. It will be a witness for you, so that you do not deny your God.

verses.kjv: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
verses.decoded: So Joshua allowed the people to leave, each person going to their own land.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.decoded: After these events, Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of one hundred and ten years.

verses.kjv: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
verses.decoded: They buried him at the edge of his inherited land in Timnath-serah, which is on Mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

verses.kjv: And Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the Lord, that he had done for Israel.
verses.decoded: Israel worshiped the LORD throughout the entire time Joshua was alive, and also during the lives of the elders who outlived Joshua and who had experienced all the works the LORD had done for Israel.

verses.kjv: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
verses.decoded: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites brought up out of Egypt, they buried in Shechem, in a piece of land that Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for one hundred pieces of silver; and it became the inheritance of the descendants of Joseph.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
verses.decoded: Eleazar, the son of Aaron, died, and they buried him on a hill that belonged to Phinehas, his son, which was given to him in Mount Ephraim.
